ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The left figure is a schematic diagram of a certain river channel, and the position marked "A" in the river channel is a mid-channel sandbar. The right figure is the curve of the area change of this sandbar within one year; the horizontal axis is from January to December, and the vertical axis indicates the size of the area; the curve shows that the sandbar area has one trough around spring, and another more obvious trough around summer. Reasoning: The area of the mid-channel sandbar becomes smaller, which usually indicates that the river water level rises, the discharge increases, and the part of the sandbar submerged by water increases. Therefore, the two area troughs in the right figure correspond to two flood seasons of the river in one year: one is the spring flood season, and one is the summer flood season. The typical region in China that has this hydrological characteristic of spring flood formed by snowmelt in spring and summer flood formed by precipitation in summer is Northeast China. Therefore, this river is located in Northeast China.
